feature_status.why: The brief requires resolving the depth-order source before building this feature. Two routes were required to be evaluated in order: (a) per-club official pages, verified club by club; (b) snap counts from an official source. Route (a) is unavailable as an OFFICIAL source because no league-official chart exists, and only 5 of 32 clubs have been acquired. Route (b) has no official source reachable from this repository. The feature is therefore not built.
what_would_unblock_it: acquisition and dated capture of all 32 club charts, or
an official snap-count or participation source for 2026
feature_status.anti_pattern_refused: Deriving depth order from jersey number, experience, salary or roster order. None of those is a depth order and using them would fabricate a starter.

jersey_number_shortcut.claim_tested: depth order can be recovered from the club roster page's jersey numbers
jersey_number_shortcut.reason: A club chart already states the order. Where a chart lists a group at rank 1, the jersey numbers within that group carry no ordering information at all. The number of group slots below shows how often the shortcut would have to invent an order that the club did not publish.
